Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ABBV.
Our cloud segment grew 20% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.77 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
